scope: Reserve authorized creation defaults in the first request, retain bounded native rejection recovery, and preserve native tool calling.
changes: Initial scope prioritizes capability-filtered defaults; successful history fills spare slots, with deduplication and a maximum of two schemas.
The production defaults task_create and reminder_create cannot be displaced by passive historical reads.
No user-text intent classifier or additional LLM routing call. Other tools remain available through discovery; a read may therefore require selection.
The existing persona asks for independent loaded operations in one batch and turnDisposition finish on the completing call.

Explicit unadvertised-tool error parsing accepts varied prefixes, whitespace, quote styles and trailing details. It still requires code 502, no returned choices, one unambiguous missing name, and current host authorization.

focused.nativeBatchRegression: Two reminders executed in one model step after two cached reads, one HTTP request, two journaled writes, and no recovery.

limitations: Proactive schema availability prevents the observed missing-reminder_create first-call mismatch, but does not force the model to batch every multi-action request.
The real simple creation completed in one model step; the real successful two-reminder run used two model steps without rejection.

One private-history double-request run received an unusable provider completion after one simulated write and stopped with provider_unavailable. This failure was not a ToolSelectionError and is not declared resolved by this scope fix.
No production deployment or GitHub push. Antigravity retains deployment ownership.
rollback: Revert this commit as a unit; c35c77c remains the bounded reactive safety net. No database migration or persistent-state change.
